137 void MmwDemo_DPC_ObjectDetection_reportFxn(void *data, uint16_t dataLen)
138 {
139  if(dataLen == sizeof(DPC_ObjectDetection_ElevEstCfg))
140  {
141  (void)memcpy((void*)&gElevEstCfg, (void*)data, dataLen);
142 
143  SemaphoreP_post(&gDPCExecSemHandle);
144  }
145  else
146  {
147  uint32_t msg = *((uint32_t*)data);
148  switch (msg)
149  {
150  case MMWDEMO_DPC_RESULT:
151  {
152  SemaphoreP_post(&gDPCExecSemHandle);
153  break;
154  }
155  default:
156  break;
157  }
158  }
159 }

269 static void MmwDemo_dssInitTask(void* args)
270 {
271 #if !MSS_AOA_ENABLED
272  uint32_t msg = 0;
273  CSL_dss_rcmRegs *ptrDssRcmRegs = (CSL_dss_rcmRegs *)CSL_DSS_RCM_U_BASE;
274 #endif
275  int32_t errCode;
276  DPM_InitCfg dpmInitCfg;
277 
278  /* Register DSP Power Down Interrupt */
279  MmwDemo_registerDSPPowerDownIntr();
280 
281  /* Initialize Power Gating configurations */
282  MMWDemo_dspPowerGateInit();
283 
284  CycleCounterP_reset();
285 
286  /* Create binary semaphore to pend Main task, */
287  (void)SemaphoreP_constructBinary(&gMmwDssMCB.dpcTaskCompleteSemHandle, 0);
288 
290  (void)SemaphoreP_constructBinary(&gDPCExecSemHandle, 0);
291 
292  /*****************************************************************************
293  * Initialization of the DPM Module:
294  *****************************************************************************/
295  (void)memset ((void *)&dpmInitCfg, 0, sizeof(DPM_InitCfg));
296 
297  /* Setup the configuration: */
298  dpmInitCfg.localEndPt = gRemoteCoreEndPt[CSL_CORE_ID_C66SS0];
299  dpmInitCfg.reportFxn = MmwDemo_DPC_ObjectDetection_reportFxn;
300  dpmInitCfg.setBitPos = DPM_DSS_BOOT_INFO_BIT_POS;
301 
302  /* Initialize the DPM Module: */
303  gMmwDssMCB.objDetDpmHandle = DPM_init (&dpmInitCfg, &errCode);
304  if (gMmwDssMCB.objDetDpmHandle == NULL)
305  {
306  DebugP_log("Error: Unable to initialize the DPM Module [Error: %d]\n", errCode);
307  DebugP_assert (false);
308  return;
309  }
310 
311  /* Synchronization: This will synchronize the execution of the control module
312  * between the domains. This is a prerequiste and always needs to be invoked. */
313  while (true)
314  {
315  int32_t syncStatus;
316 
317  /* Get the synchronization status: */
318  syncStatus = DPM_synch (gMmwDssMCB.objDetDpmHandle, &errCode);
319  if (syncStatus < 0)
320  {
321  /* Error: Unable to synchronize the framework */
322  DebugP_log("Error: DPM Synchronization failed [Error code %d]\n", errCode);
323  DebugP_assert (false);
324  return;
325  }
326  if ((uint32_t)syncStatus == CSL_FMKR(DPM_DSS_BOOT_INFO_BIT_POS, DPM_MSS_BOOT_INFO_BIT_POS, 7U))
327  {
328  /* Synchronization acheived: */
329  break;
330  }
331  /* Sleep and poll again: */
332  ClockP_usleep(1U * 1000U);
333  }
334 
335  /* wait for the configs to be available */
336  /* if AoA proc runs on MSS, no config will be sent from MSS and execution will be stalled here */
337  (void)SemaphoreP_pend(&gDPCExecSemHandle, SystemP_WAIT_FOREVER);
338 
339 #if !MSS_AOA_ENABLED
340  /* send the ack for config received */
341  msg = MMWDEMO_DPC_ELEVEST_CFG;
342  errCode = DPM_send(gMmwDssMCB.objDetDpmHandle, (void*)(&msg), sizeof(uint32_t), CSL_CORE_ID_R5FSS0_0);
343  DebugP_assert(0U == errCode);
344 
345  while(1)
346  {
347  SemaphoreP_pend(&gDPCExecSemHandle, SystemP_WAIT_FOREVER);
348  DPC_ObjectDetection_ExecuteResult *result = gElevEstCfg.commonCfg.result;
349 
350  DPC_ObjDet_estimateXYZ(&gElevEstCfg,
351  (DetObjParams*)SOC_phyToVirt((uint32_t)result->detObjList), /* Translate the detObjList address (DSS_L2) from M4 core view to DSS core view. */
352  result->objOut,
353  result->dopNumObjOut,
354  &result->numObjOut);
355 
356  /* Notify the MSS that results are ready in L3 RAM for export. */
357  msg = MMWDEMO_DPC_RESULT;
358  errCode = DPM_send(gMmwDssMCB.objDetDpmHandle, (void*)(&msg), sizeof(uint32_t), CSL_CORE_ID_R5FSS0_0);
359  DebugP_assert(0U == errCode);
360  if ( gElevEstCfg.commonCfg.dspStateAfterFrameProc == MMWDEMO_DSP_UC_ENABLE)
361  {
362  /* Underclock DSP core (XTAL) */
363  ptrDssRcmRegs->DSS_DSP_CLK_SRC_SEL = MMWDEMO_DSP_CLK_SRC_XTAL;
364  }
365  else if (gElevEstCfg.commonCfg.dspStateAfterFrameProc == MMWDEMO_DSP_PG_ENABLE)
366  {
367  /* Power Gate DSP */
368  contextSave.altPc = 0x12345678;
369  }
370  }
371 #endif
372 }

382 int main (void)
383 {
384 
385  /* init SOC specific modules */
386  System_init();
387  Board_init();
388 
389  /* Initialize and populate the demo MCB */
390  (void)memset ((void*)&gMmwDssMCB, 0, sizeof(gMmwDssMCB));
391 
392  /* It is the only task running on this core at highest priority */
393  gMmwDssMCB.objDetDpcTaskHandle = xTaskCreateStatic( MmwDemo_dssInitTask,
394  "MmwDemo_dssInitTask",
395  MMWDEMO_DPC_TASK_STACK_SIZE,
396  NULL,
397  MMWDEMO_DPC_TASK_PRI,
398  gMmwDemo_dpcTaskStack,
399  &gMmwDssMCB.objDetDpcTaskObj );
400  configASSERT(gMmwDssMCB.objDetDpcTaskHandle != NULL);
401 
402  /* Start the scheduler to start the tasks executing. */
403  vTaskStartScheduler();
404 
405  /* The following line should never be reached because vTaskStartScheduler()
406  will only return if there was not enough FreeRTOS heap memory available to
407  create the Idle and (if configured) Timer tasks. Heap management, and
408  techniques for trapping heap exhaustion, are described in the book text. */
409  DebugP_assertNoLog(0);
410 
411  return 0;
412 }
